question: Can a later logged Linux comparison distinguish router entry from authorization or missing attachment without installing Linux?

distribution.name: SystemRescue13.02 amd64
distribution.verification: SHA256 matches publisher; GnuPG GOODSIG/VALIDSIG and exit0 against the published key. Trust is undefined in the isolated local keyring; no OS trust-store change.

image_contents.config_extraction: Decode the verified ISO kernel zstd frame, then the embedded IKCFG_ST gzip configuration. Local zstandard0.25.0 used for decompression only; kernel/config remain private.
image_contents.limit: Compiled-in/module capabilities in the pinned distribution; not proof of ASUS module binding, successful boot or exposed tracepoints at runtime.

collector.default: Preview only; capture requires explicit --capture inside the prepared Linux USB.
capture: USB4 router topology, authorization and link attributes
Type-C roles/mode and cached partner identity when exposed
USB VID/PID hierarchy and PCIe device inventory
Kernel log, kernel uevents and available thunderbolt/ucsi/typec tracepoints
collector.persistence: Exact prepared boot-USB marker and payload hashes, direct vfat mount and independently checked USB storage ancestry. Writes only that boot medium and RAM logging controls, restoring original boot-mount RO state.
collector.supervision: Own Popen logger processes, private trace instance, trace statistics, monotonic trace clock when supported,32MiB per-file limit,45-second sampling window.
limits: No first boot, real USB persistence or actual hardware capture yet.
No raw CC/PD transcript or applied PS8830 state.
Router presence alone does not establish native USB4 rather than TBT3-compatible mode.
New display endpoints need topology review; internal GPU is not counted as a new endpoint.
Logger/metadata availability and total runtime depend on the kernel;45seconds is the observation window.

validation.default_preview: passed on Windows, without hardware I/O
validation.overlay_manifest: Four payload files independently hash-checked; line endings normalized to LF.

owner_action: No action while remote. Before writing a USB, identify the exact device and verify its original research files are independently preserved. A local boot is a later owner-directed action.
investigation_limit: Preparation is not a Linux result or Windows fix. Original firmware-consumer work remains open.
record_scope: Original preparation record, retained unchanged within prepared_kit. Current collector/source status is in the later audit.
